  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  Repeat.

Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Phantom Steed (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Glorious Protector (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
  When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
  Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Glorious Protector to return from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
  Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
  When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
  Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
  Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
  When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
  When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
  When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

  Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
  Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
  Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.

Start: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward (battlefield); Ghostly Flicker (hand); Archaeomancer (exile)

  Repeat.

  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.

Start: Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Phantom Steed (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Changeling Hero (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: WU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{W}{U}{U} each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Scholar of the Ages (battlefield); Time Warp (hand); Daydream (hand)
Steps: Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
  Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
  When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat each turn.

  Repeat each turn.

  When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
  When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
  When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Color identity: WU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 14 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {11}{W}{U} at most each turn
Produces: Near-infinite turns; Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Eternity Vessel (hand); Resourceful Defense (battlefield); Magistrate's Scepter (battlefield); Drafna, Founder of Lat-Nam (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Your life total is 3 or higher.
Steps: Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. Eternity Vessel enters the battlefield with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
  Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all charge counters from Eternity Vessel onto Magistrate's Scepter.
  Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  If Magistrate's Scepter has few than three charge counters on it, activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Eternity Vessel from the battlefield to your hand.
  Repeat from step 3 during your next turn if Magistrate's Scepter has three or more charge counters on it. Otherwise, repeat from step 1.
Notes: The amount of mana you need to pay each turn varies based off your starting life total. You can also stagger the steps across turns, possibly, to save paying lots of mana in one turn. You could also copy Eternity Vessel using Drafna's first ability, if desired/able, and move the counters from the token onto Magistrate's Scepter.
